note: VB-CABLE is optional and downloaded on request. Native UxPlay is compiled from pinned upstream source; managed only through canvas AirPlay lines.

summary.zh-CN: 把混音结果写入一块虚拟声卡，供 Zoom、微信、OBS 等应用当作麦克风读取。驱动安装需要管理员权限，装完需重启。
summary.en-US: Publishes the mix through a virtual sound card that Zoom, Teams or OBS can read as a microphone. The driver needs administrator rights and a reboot.

summary.zh-CN: AirPlay 接收需要 Apple Bonjour 服务和 64 位 dnssd.dll。仅在选择后从 Apple 下载，官方安装器可能要求管理员确认；不会打包或复制 Apple 的运行库。
summary.en-US: AirPlay needs Apple Bonjour and 64-bit dnssd.dll. Downloaded from Apple only after selection; its installer may request administrator confirmation. Apple binaries are not bundled.

names.zh-CN: AirPlay 音频接收插件（原生 UxPlay）

summary.zh-CN: 随 MeshAudio 自动安装，无需另行下载或编译。点击“自动配置 AirPlay”会检查插件并自动下载安装缺少的 Bonjour；完成后在画布添加 iOS 源。Windows 可能要求管理员确认和允许专用网络访问。
summary.en-US: Installed automatically with MeshAudio; no separate download or compilation. Auto-setup checks the plugin and installs missing Bonjour. Then add an iOS source on the canvas. Windows may request administrator approval and private-network access.
